Diflubenzuron 1-(4-Chlorophenyl)-3-(2,6-difluorobenzoyl)urea. C14H9ClF2N2O2 = 310.7. CAS — 35367-38-5. ATC Vet — QP53BC02. Profile Diflubenzuron is an insecticide and larvicide that acts as a growth regulator by interfering with the formation of cuticle. It is used in agriculture and for the control of disease vectors. Diflubenzuron possesses residual activity against mosquito lar- vae. ◊ References. 1. WHO. Diflubenzuron. health and safety guide. IPCS Health and Safety Guide 99. Geneva: WHO, 1995.
